articles.title: Congo’s Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 cases as authorities race to slow the spread in African countries - AP News
articles.description: Congo’s fast-moving Ebola outbreak has topped 10,000 confirmed cases as authorities race to slow the spread across Africa. Data from Congo's Ministry of Health on Tuesday showed there have been a total of 10,060 confirmed cases, nearly half of whom have died.…
articles.content: BUNIA, Congo (AP) The fast-moving Ebola outbreak in Congo has reached 10,000 confirmed cases, government data showed Tuesday, as health authorities race to slow the spread of the disease in multiple … [+6023 chars]
